ios.desc:
Mockup helps you sketch, wireframe, and prototype apps and websites across iPad, iPhone, and Mac. Built specifically for UI/UX design and Apple Pencil, Mockup combines a flexible canvas with reusable UI elements and interactive prototypes in one seamless workflow.

Featured by Apple and recognized as App of the Day, Mockup is trusted by 500,000+ designers, developers, and product teams worldwide to sketch and wireframe interfaces faster.

Design interfaces for mobile, tablet, desktop, watch, TV, and the web.

- Sketch naturally with Apple Pencil using versatile drawing tools and a complete color palette.
- Work with 45+ device frames in portrait and landscape.
- Draw perfect shapes with Shape Detection and Snap to Grid for cleaner layouts.
- Write and edit text directly on the canvas using Scribble.
- Customize grids, frames, and backgrounds to match your workflow.

Build Better Wireframes

- Use ready-to-use UI elements or create, save, and reuse your own custom element sets.
- Add text, images, shapes, and over 4,000 SF Symbols.
- Save reusable text styles for a consistent design system.
- Drag and drop text or images directly from other apps.

Prototype User Flows

- Connect screens to create interactive flows.
- Preview prototypes in full-screen mode.
- Validate navigation and user experience before development.

Export, Share & Continue Anywhere

- Export high-quality PDF and PNG files.
- Share Mockup files with other users.
- Collaborate in real time using SharePlay.
- Sync sketches and projects across iPad, iPhone, and Mac with iCloud.
- Access recent sketches and preview your work from Home Screen widgets.

Optimized for Apple Pencil & iPad

- Use Apple Pencil Hover to preview and switch drawing tools with greater precision and control.
- Use Apple Pencil Pro squeeze to access canvas controls, adjust tools, select objects, or undo and redo actions.
- Enjoy a desktop-class experience with external keyboard and trackpad support.
- Work across multiple windows for greater productivity.

Start creating for free with unlimited sketches and projects, or unlock the complete Mockup experience with Mockup Studio.

Mockup Studio includes:
- All device frames
- Interactive prototypes
- Unlimited custom element sets
- Exclusive UI elements
- Shape Detection
- 4,000+ customizable SF Symbols
- Watermark-free PDF export
- PNG export
- Nested projects
- Priority support

show_hn.title: Show HN: Mockup – A UI/UX Sketching App for iPad Got a Major Update

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

I’d like to introduce, our app, Mockup - the ideal design tool for sketching and creating blueprints for apps or web designs.

One of my end goals is to make the design process easy and intuitive and that's exactly what Mockup does with its 45+ templates, flexible canvas, Library to save your elements, and a range of other attributes. With features like the Lasso tool, text and image insertion, 4000 symbols from Apple's SF Symbols library, and a customizable grid, your design possibilities are endless.

And, the best part? I've just released a brand new update, packed with features suggested by our users to make the design experience even better like arrange objects, copy & paste, and an enhanced toolbar. Not to mention, users can now publish their elements to the community and access elements created by others as well as create UI  for TV apps with the highly requested newly added TV template.

I can't wait for you to try it out!
